resources.string: OEA Floating Workspace — Enables OEA to show and interact with supported apps inside movable floating windows. Used to map taps and keystrokes from OEA’s window to the target app’s real interface. You can disable at any time in Settings > Accessibility.
OEA needs “Display over other apps” to show its floating workspace above your current app. It does not replace freeform windows — it is OEA’s own presentation layer.
Paused — target app not in foreground
Content hidden — app uses secure screen
Not interactive — bring target app to foreground or check permissions
